title: Irs Metric1 Rolling 7-Day Value Average
dataSources: TurboTax returns (`turbotax:return`), IRS transcripts (`irs:transcript`), tax estimates (`tax:estimate`), tax payments (`tax:payment`), and W-2 imports (`w2:import`).
app: TurboTax return exports, IRS transcript pulls, tax estimate calculators, payment confirmations, and W-2 import logs ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=irs:metric1 value=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(value) as daily_avg by _time
| streamstats window=7 avg(daily_avg) as rolling_7d
| sort _time
description: Tracks a seven-day rolling average of daily value for irs metric1 (1) data.
value: Rolling averages highlight gradual drift without overreacting to one-off days.
implementation: Compute daily average `value` then a seven-day rolling mean for irs metric1 (1) events.
visualization: Line chart of daily and rolling average value.
grandmaExplanation: It combines the smoothed week-long trend in your value from irs metric1 (1).
